ga4_regex_note: RE2-compatible custom channel group condition for Session source (our construction from the research, section 2.6). It is anchored and allows subdomains, so it works whether GA4 applies a full or partial match. Place the channel above Referral and do not also require medium = referral, or UTM-tagged ChatGPT clicks are missed.

ga4_channel.name: AI Assistant
ga4_channel.label: V
ga4_channel.notes: GA4's default channel group includes AI Assistant (medium exactly ai-assistant, or a referrer on Google's internal list; examples named: ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Copilot, Grok). The launch date (about 2026-05-13) and whether Perplexity or Claude are on the list are known from third parties only.

notes: Google AI Overviews and AI Mode traffic stays in GA4 Organic Search, not in the AI Assistant channel (fact:F-AI-30). In Search Console it is counted inside the Web search type (fact:F-T-50).
Many AI-app sessions arrive without a referrer and land in Direct, so every AI referral count is a floor, not a total.
kagi.com, you.com and phind.com also run classic search; their traffic is not purely AI-answer traffic.
Which referrer each AI app or AI browser actually sends is reported by third parties only; verify against your own data before reporting a trend.
